items.title: Contents (one QR code per line)
items.description: URLs, plain text, WiFi strings (WIFI:S:MyNetwork;T:WPA;P:password;;), vCards, or anything else. One QR code is generated per line.

format.title: Image format
format.description: PNG for print and messaging, SVG for infinite-resolution vector use.

size.title: Size in pixels (PNG)
size.description: Width and height of PNG output. Ignored for SVG.

errorCorrection.title: Error correction
errorCorrection.description: Higher levels survive more damage or overlaid logos but make denser codes. M is the everyday default.

margin.title: Quiet zone (modules)
margin.description: White border around the code. Keep at least 2 for reliable scanning.

darkColor.title: Foreground color
darkColor.description: Hex color of the QR modules, e.g. #000000 or #1a1a2e.
